- **Spend:** $347.44 of $350.00 USD

The post "Please take a look at our app..." (2152361729849701644) was not promoted. It has no install or offer language, so I left it out.

**What I set up**
- One campaign, "Orbiloom Valentine's Things I Notice (Feb 10-14, 2027) - iOS link clicks," billed to the Amex ending 1519.
- One ad group: link-click goal, $70/day, $350 lifetime cap, scheduled from Feb 10 00:00 to Feb 14 23:59:59 Auckland time (NZDT, UTC+13).
- Platform targeting limited to iOS, placements ALL_ON_TWITTER, worldwide, no other targeting.
- The three top-performing posts ran together. Their cost per click stayed within about $0.05 of each other, so I didn't cut any. The cap ran out right at the end of the flight, so spend was spread evenly.

**Issues you should know about**
1. **Sanctioned countries were not excluded.** The landing page says the app is unavailable in Iran, North Korea, Cuba and Syria. The targeting search didn't return any of these as country criteria, so I couldn't exclude them. The ads ran worldwide, so some spend and clicks may have come from those countries. I didn't pull a country breakdown, so I can't say how much. You may want to review this before the next flight.
2. **The approved posts are English only.** All four are in English. You mentioned localized versions for every market, but none were among the four posts you approved. Non-English markets probably saw nothing from this run.
3. **Installs are not measured.** The site has no X pixel and there's no app-install campaign, so I have no install count. Check the App Store Connect install data for Feb 10 to Feb 14 to find out what this run delivered.

I didn't create any new posts, and I didn't change the landing page or the unlock deadline.
